summary: @NomadWarMachine not at all but if it is public everything on @hypothes_is is in public domain. Need to dispose that and be cautious if using with students. Not comfortable with forcing them to give up rights as required class participation. We just keep public and use #clmooc tab
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@NomadWarMachine not at all but if it is public everything on @hypothes_is is in public domain. Need to dispose that and be cautious if using with students.

Not comfortable with forcing them to give up rights as required class participation.

We just keep public and use #clmooc tab
